spell.mageadditions.piercing.guide: Imbue yourself with piercing magic for a duration. While active, projectiles you fire pass through creatures they hit and can continue into additional targets. Projectiles still collide with blocks normally.
spell.mageadditions.mirror_image.guide: Vanish completely and leave behind a convincing copy of yourself. The copy raises a shield, evades its first two hits, then disappears in a poof on the next hit. It remembers your equipped spells and fake-casts them at creatures that attack it; straightforward projectile spells are reproduced visually but all damage from the copy is nullified.
spell.mageadditions.capture.guide: Trap the living creature you are aiming at in place. Captured players can rapidly press the Struggle key to break free early. Cast Capture again while you have a captive to release them. Non-player creatures remain trapped until the spell expires or you release them.
message.mageadditions.capture.captured_p: Captured! Spam the Struggle key to break free.
